typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SourceSystem as string,
		XVATradeaID as string,
		TradeID as string,
		ProductType as string,
		WCISID as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		NettingGroupID as string,
		AgreementID as string,
		CptyHazardCurveCode as string,
		Tenor as string,
		Input as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		Filename as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> tblXVADailyArchive
tblXVADailyArchive derive({Check Source} = iif(iif(iif(iif(SourceSystem == 'CLYP12', 'Rates', SourceSystem == 'CMR'), 'FX', SourceSystem == 'ENDUR'), 'Commodities', SourceSystem == 'IMAGIN'), 'Equities', '')) ~> DerivedColumn
tblXVADailyArchive aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		AgreementID as string,
		TradeID as string,
		ProductType as string,
		Org_SourceSystem as string,
		Tenor as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		XVATradeaID as string,
		Input as string,
		NettingGroupID as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		WCISID as string,
		CptyHazardCurveCode as string,
		SourceSystem as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		AgreementID,
		TradeID,
		ProductType,
		Org_SourceSystem = {Copy of Check Source},
		Tenor,
		CounterParty,
		XVATradeaID,
		Input,
		NettingGroupID,
		Loaddate,
		WCISID,
		CptyHazardCurveCode,
		SourceSystem),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
